select t.* from ( select DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM ( SELECT algorithm_code, tenant_id FROM vm_order_algorithms WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} UNION SELECT algorithm_code, tenant_id FROM vm_order_algorithms_his WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} ) t1 inner JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t t2 ON t1.algorithm_code = t2.algorithm_code inner JOIN vm_algorithm_alarm al ON t2.algo_min_type_code = al.algo_min_type inner JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON al.alarm_type = sat.type_value WHERE sat.alarm_source = '1' and t2.app_scenarios = '1' ${body.dataScope} ORDER BY sat.alarm_type_id ASC ) t union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.alarm_source in
#{alarmSource}
and ((sat.tenant_id is null and sat.industry_code is null) or (sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} and sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode})) union SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, COALESCE(sat.type_name, cfg.itemName) AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS typeValue FROM ( SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} UNION SELECT algorithm_code FROM vm_order_algorithms_his WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND industry_code = #{body.industryCode} ) algo INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t a ON algo.algorithm_code = a.algorithm_code AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.algorithm_model_type = 2 INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE( a.model_config, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( code VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.code', NESTED PATH '$.dictList[*]' COLUMNS ( itemCode VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.itemCode', itemName VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.itemName' ) ) ) cfg LEFT JOIN sys_alarm_type sat ON sat.type_value = cfg.itemCode COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sat.delete_flag = 0 AND ( (sat.source = 3 AND sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode}) OR IFNULL(sat.source, 0) != 3 ) WHERE a.model_config IS NOT NULL AND a.model_config != '' AND LOWER(cfg.code) LIKE '%modetype%' AND cfg.itemCode IS NOT NULL AND cfg.itemCode != '' union
SELECT DISTINCT sat.alarm_type_id AS alarmTypeId, sat.type_name AS typeName, sat.icon AS icon, sat.type_value AS typeValue FROM sys_alarm_type sat WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 AND IFNULL(sat.source, 0) = 3 AND sat.tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} AND sat.industry_code = #{body.industryCode} AND sat.type_value IS NOT NULL AND sat.type_value != ''
select count(*) from vm_order_services_rel where tenant_id = #{body.tenantId} and ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and industry_code = #{body.industryCode} and service_code = '9' and delete_flag = 0

SELECT rel.waring_order_id, group_concat( rel.lable_name SEPARATOR ',' ) AS lable_name FROM vm_alarm_lable_rel rel
and rel.waring_order_id in
#{item}
GROUP BY rel.waring_order_id
